name: macdoc
description: Remote app dock and control surface for a Windows PC, driven from a phone on the same LAN.

scripts.build:mac: swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -o MacDocInput native/mac/MacDocInput.swift && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -o MacDocAudio native/mac/MacDocAudio.swift -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/mac/MacDocAudio-Info.plist && codesign -f -s - -i com.sleepyunicon.macdoc.audio MacDocAudio && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -o MacDocWindows native/mac/MacDocWindows.swift
